synthetic: rowwise optical warp and printed copy
progression: Qualified sample4/A native interval appearance retained, B/C and all three texture guides not upper-cellular, useful difference from ablation without lost positives; missing/unresolved is not rejection. Copy/warp structural collision blocks generic adoption.
stop: One fixed readout plus one ablation. No threshold/radius/sign/reference rescue.
synthetic_warp: Each row i is cyclically translated by round(3*sin(i/7)) pixels; compare identical printed copy, not a new truth source.
